Synapse runs on your PostgreSQL as configured, federation works without extra proxy rules, and TURN can run over TLS.

## ✨ Added

- **`ENABLE_REGISTRATION`** (default `false`) turns on open signup and shows Element's **Create Account** button. Only switch it on behind a CAPTCHA or on a trusted network, or expect spam accounts.
- **`TURN_DOMAIN` and `TURN_PORT`** route voice and video through their own subdomain or a remapped port. The `turn_uris` Synapse hands out follow them.
- **TURN over TLS.** Mount `fullchain.pem` and `privkey.pem` at `/data/certs` and coturn listens for TLS on 5349, with matching `turns:` URIs in Synapse. Plain TURN on 3478 stays as a fallback. `TURN_TLS_ENABLE`, `TURN_TLS_PORT`, `TURN_TLS_CERT` and `TURN_TLS_KEY` override the defaults.
- **A READY banner in the log** once Synapse answers its health check, so you can see when the first start (30 to 60 seconds) is done.
- **A Docker Hub mirror.** The image is also published as `junkerderprovinz/matrix` on Docker Hub. GHCR stays the primary registry.

## 🎨 Design

- The container prints the house ASCII banner at startup.

## ⚡ Improved

- The Unraid template now lives in the central templates feed and pulls from Docker Hub. Its project link goes to the Matrix website.
- CI boots every image against a throwaway PostgreSQL and waits for `/health` before it publishes `latest`.
- When an old `/data/homeserver.db` is found, the log warns that Synapse now uses PostgreSQL and points to `synapse_port_db`.
- The federation and TURN over TLS sections of the README were rewritten. The certificate has to be valid for `TURN_DOMAIN`, or clients reject `turns:` and calls fail.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Synapse uses PostgreSQL.** The overrides file was included with a directive Synapse does not know, so it never loaded and Synapse ran on SQLite in `/data/homeserver.db`. It is now passed as a second `--config-path`. Thanks to @paulmeier for #3 and #4.
- **Before you update an install that ran on SQLite**, either port the data with [`synapse_port_db`](https://element-hq.github.io/synapse/latest/postgres.html#porting-from-sqlite) or move the old file aside (`docker exec Matrix mv /data/homeserver.db /data/homeserver.db.old`) to start fresh on PostgreSQL. Your rooms and users stay in that file until you port them.
- **Synapse starts with URL previews on.** It refused to start without `url_preview_ip_range_blacklist`, which showed up as a 502 at the proxy. The overrides now carry the standard upstream blacklist, which also keeps the preview fetcher away from private addresses.
- **Federation discovery works out of the box.** Synapse serves `/.well-known/matrix/server` and `/client` itself and delegates federation to port 443, so manual `.well-known` locations in the proxy can go. Resolves #5, thanks to @i-byrana.
- **`ADMIN_USER` promotes an existing account to server admin.** An account registered in Element first stayed a normal user, and the admin UI failed with "Server communication error". The password is left alone. Thanks to the reporter of #6.
- A failed first config generation stops the container with an error. It used to leave a stub `homeserver.yaml` behind and crash on every later start.
- The admin bootstrap retries after a transient error instead of marking itself done.
- The coturn relay port range is pinned and exposed in the template, so relayed calls go through.
- `homeserver-overrides.yaml`, which holds the database password and the TURN secret, is written with mode 600.
